name: applywise
description: Job search and form filling; dry run by default, real submits need your approval or consent.
long_description: ApplyWise searches public job boards and fills application forms. It is a dry run until the user changes their own config. Real submits, ATS logins (from the OS keychain, never shown to the model) and emailed verification codes need the user's approval, or a consent window the user opens in a terminal; visible CAPTCHAs and flagged attestations always go to the user. Run `applywise init` and `applywise doctor` in a terminal first.
